title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（高野則之研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Takano Noriyuki)
teachers:
TAKANO Noriyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Students will (1) learn technical mechanisms and new mechanisms required to research, develop, design, and manufacture socially useful and high-quality products using the basic academic ability acquired by studies in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, (2) scquire the ability to identify and solve problems in mechanical engineering-related fields, (3) learn about the importance of collaboration, particularly with local communities.
advice:
This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department, this course focuses on the following topics:
Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.
In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.)
Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process.

Our laboratory promotes projects with the following content:
(1) materials assositaed with hydrogen energy (2) biomedical engineering ( matrials and treatments) (3) techniques for material design

Students will learns theory, experimental procedure and computer simulation in thees projects.
requiredKnowledge:
It is essential to acquire knowledge and improve the skills necessary for safe research activities.
It is desirable to obtain a machining license from the KIT Dream works (Yumekobo).

activityGoals.body: Be able to advance your project in accordance with the engineering design process.
Be able to compile your results correctly into an article and discuss the content through presentations.
Be able to act independently to solve the issues presented separately.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the your project and the advancement
process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System.
(2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present and discuss its content. Complete the final report, present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board, and discuss its content.
(3) If necessary, design and manufacture your own experimental devices, and also evaluate the performance of the product.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System. (2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present its content. Complete the final report and present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board. (3) Design and manufacture your own experimental devices as necessary. (The numbers in the text correspond to those of the student's action goals.)

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department, this course focuses on the following topics:
Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.
In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.)
Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process.

Our laboratory promotes projects with the following content:
(1) materials assositaed with hydrogen energy (2) biomedical engineering ( matrials and treatments) (3) techniques for material design

Students will learns theory, experimental procedure and computer simulation in thees projects.
